items.exampleEn: Most of my classmates agree with me.
items.exampleZh: 我大部分的同學都同意我的看法。

items.exampleEn: Please ask your dad to call me back.
Where does your teacher come from?
I often dream of living by the sea.
When did you get back from your trip?
items.exampleZh: 你什麼時候旅行回來的？

items.exampleEn: It's hot today. The temperature went up to 35 degrees.
items.exampleZh: 今天很熱，氣溫上升到 35 度。

items.exampleEn: The number of visitors to the museum went down this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年博物館的參觀人數下降了。

items.sentenceEn: My grandparents come from a small town in the south.
items.sentenceZh: 我的祖父母來自南部的一個小鎮。

items.audioEn: Sorry, Mr. Lin is not in the office. Can he call you back later?
items.audioZh: 抱歉，林先生不在辦公室。他晚一點回你電話好嗎？
items.questionZh: 說話的人說林先生晚一點可以做什麼？
options: Meet you at the front door

items.sentenceEn: My English grades went up a lot this year.
items.sentenceZh: 我今年的英文成績進步很多。

items.sentenceEn: I finally got my money back from the shop.
items.sentenceZh: 我終於從那家店拿回我的錢了。

items.stemEn: Food prices ____ a lot last month, so we eat out less now.
items.stemZh: 上個月食物價格漲了很多，所以我們現在比較少在外面吃飯。

items.stemEn: Do you ____ me, or do you have a different idea?
items.stemZh: 你同意我的看法嗎？還是你有不同的想法？

items.passageEn: Leo comes from a small village in the mountains. He dreams of being a cook in a big city. Last month, a restaurant in Taipei called him back after his interview and offered him a job. His mother didn't agree with his plan because rent in the city often goes up. But Leo found a cheap room near the restaurant, and now his mother is happy for him.
items.passageZh: Leo 來自山裡的一個小村莊。他夢想在大城市當廚師。上個月，台北的一家餐廳在面試後回他電話，給了他一份工作。他媽媽不同意他的計畫，因為城市的房租常常上漲。不過 Leo 在餐廳附近找到一間便宜的房間，現在他媽媽替他高興。

questions.questionZh: 餐廳在面試後做了什麼？
options: 說他們已經找到別的人了

questions.questionZh: Leo 的媽媽為什麼不同意？

items.promptZh: 昨天河裡的水位下降了。
referenceEn: The water level in the river went down yesterday.
Yesterday the water level in the river went down.
The river's water level went down yesterday.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 went down 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 dropped、fell 等）也算對
「昨天」的事用過去式（例如 went down、dropped、fell 等）
「河裡的水位」可寫，例如 the water level in the river、the river's water level 等

items.promptZh: 我現在很忙，我晚一點回你電話。
referenceEn: I'm busy now. I'll call you back later.
I am busy right now, so I will call you back later.
I'm busy now, but I'll call you back later.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 call you back 等（代名詞 you 放中間）
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 return your call、call you later 等）也算對
晚一點要做的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 I'll call、I will call、I'm going to call 等）
兩句可分開寫，也可以用 so、but 等連接
